documentation_excerpts.text: Schemathesis tests OpenAPI and GraphQL APIs by generating inputs from your schema, adapting to server responses, and chaining operations into realistic workflows.
```console # Test a demo API - finds real bugs in 30 seconds uvx schemathesis run https://example.schemathesis.io/openapi.json
# Test your own API uvx schemathesis run https://your-api.com/openapi.json ```
